title.en: Thinking of My Brothers on a Moonlit Night

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource (from Three Hundred Tang Poems).
edition.zh: 据维基文库（《唐诗三百首》本）。

basis.en: Tang dynasty poem; the author died in 770.

note.en: Written in 759 during the An Lushan rebellion, when Du Fu’s brothers were scattered across the country and letters rarely got through. The second couplet is famous for its quiet strangeness: the dew is white ‘from tonight’ because tonight is the White Dew solar term, and the moon is ‘brighter at home’, which is not true and is exactly how it feels.
note.zh: 759 年安史之乱中所作，那时杜甫的弟弟们流散各地，书信难通。第二联以平静中的奇异著称：露“从今夜白”，因为今夜正是白露节气；月“是故乡明”，这并非事实，却正是那种感觉。

excerpt.orig: 露從今夜白，月是故鄉明。
excerpt.en: From tonight the dew turns white; / the moon is brighter over home.
excerpt.zh: 露从今夜白，月是故乡明。

gloss.en: The garrison drums, beaten at nightfall as a curfew.
gloss.zh: 戍鼓：戍楼上的更鼓，鼓响后禁止通行。

gloss.en: A lone goose: geese fly in ordered lines, an old figure for brothers, so a single one calling is a brother separated.
gloss.zh: 孤雁的叫声。雁行有序，古人以“雁行”喻兄弟，孤雁暗指兄弟离散。

gloss.en: Tonight is White Dew, the solar term that falls in the eighth lunar month, early in September.
gloss.zh: 这一夜正是白露节气，在农历八月，约当公历九月上旬。

gloss.en: Du Fu had four younger brothers; when he wrote this at Qinzhou in 759, the An Lushan rebellion had scattered them.
gloss.zh: 杜甫有四个弟弟。759 年他在秦州作此诗时，兄弟们因安史之乱流离各地。

gloss.en: The fighting has not stopped: the rebellion lasted from 755 to 763.
gloss.zh: 战争还没有停止。安史之乱从 755 年持续到 763 年。
